speakers.name: Stefan Grosjean
speakers.biography_html:
Stefan Grosjean (°1963) grew up in Flanders, Belgium, and earned a Master of Science in Industrial Engineering, specializing in Computer Science and Electronics. In 1991, Stefan founded EnergyICT, a pioneering company in energy solutions for commercial and industrial businesses. Over the next two decades, EnergyICT became a global leader in energy management technologies, laying the foundation for Stefan’s reputation as a visionary in the clean-tech industry. He sold the company in 2009.

Building on this success, in 2012 Stefan founded Smappee, an innovative company that focuses on optimizing energy consumption and accelerating the transition to renewable energy. Smappee is internationally recognized for its intelligent EV chargers and smart energy management solutions, which blend functionality with sleek design. Under his leadership, Smappee has won numerous prestigious awards, including the Henry Van De Velde Award, the Red Dot Award, and the iF Design Award. As of October 2024, Stefan transitioned to the role of CEO of Smappee Group, the umbrella body over the various Smappee ventures. In this new role, he remains closely involved in Smappee's management but with a sharpened focus on the visionary innovation and strategy of the Group to ensure Smappee's accelerated growth and leading position in the industry.

In addition to his role at Smappee, Stefan founded  Snowball in 2018, a cutting-edge Cleantech Hub in Harelbeke. Snowball serves as the headquarters of Smappee and acts as a collaborative space and living lab for clean-tech innovation, bringing together companies and experts focused on sustainable energy and environmental solutions.

With over 30 years of experience, Stefan is a recognized leader in the global energy transition, consistently striving to blend cutting-edge technology with high-functioning design and sustainable growth strategies. His passion for innovation and commitment to positive societal and environmental impact continue to drive his entrepreneurial ventures.

speakers.name: Géry Debongnie (ged) & Thiry Cédric (cth)
speakers.biography_html:
Gery is an accomplished software developer with extensive expertise in JavaScript. He has played a pivotal role in Odoo codebase, starting even before it was called Odoo. Géry is not only known for his contributions to projects like the Owl UI framework, the Odoo web client, and the Odoo Spreadsheets application but also for his leadership as the head of the JavaScript framework team.

Cédric joined Odoo in 2019 as a Business Analyst. After years of project implementations from various sizes and sectors, he moved to the R&D department to endorse the role of Product Owner. Since 2024, he is responsible for the functional aspects of the technical features produced by the Framework JS and ORM teams.

speakers.name: Amit Parik
speakers.biography_html:
My name is Amit Parik, and I am the Managing Partner at BrowseInfo, an Odoo Gold Partner that has been providing Odoo services since 2013. Before starting BrowseInfo, I worked at Odoo (formerly OpenERP), which gave me deep insight into the product, roadmap, and best practices for successful implementations.

At BrowseInfo, we focus on business consulting and end‑to‑end Odoo implementation, not just development. As a long‑standing Gold Partner, we help customers with process analysis, solution design, configuration, customisation, integrations, training, support, and continuous improvement on Odoo. Over the years, I have led and overseen 100+ Odoo implementations across India and around the world in industries such as pharma, manufacturing, trading, services, retail, NGOs, education, and temples.

BrowseInfo is also known in the Odoo ecosystem for its large portfolio of ready‑to‑use Odoo apps and vertical solutions on the Odoo Apps store, which partners and end customers use to accelerate their projects and reduce custom development.

One of my flagship projects is with Sasmar Pharmaceuticals, a global pharma group that has been on Odoo for more than a decade. Starting from Odoo 7 and now on Odoo 19 Enterprise, we supported Sasmar’s growth from 6 to 22 companies across multiple countries, with Odoo as the backbone for ERP, eCommerce, multi‑website, and marketplace integrations. This long‑term journey has given me strong experience in multi‑company, multi‑currency architectures, complex rollouts, and multi‑version upgrades, turning Odoo into a true core system for international businesses.

d’informations. Passionnée par l’éducation et le futur du travail, elle a cofondé et préside l’Observatoire des Métiers du Futur, think-tank qui vise à impacter
positivement les entreprises et le débat public sur ce thème. Elle est lieutenante-colonelle et réserviste citoyenne auprès de l’Armée de Terre, et a été
ambassadrice numérique auprès de la Commission Européenne. Elle a publié Les métiers du Futur aux éditions FIRST en 2019, et Emploi 4.0 aux éditions
Atlande en 2021. Enfin, elle est l’hôtesse du podcast Les métiers du Futur depuis 2021, qui dépasse désormais les 110 000 écoutes et totalise plus de 140
épisodes. Sa parfaite connaissance de l’univers de la Tech et sa vision prospective des métiers et de l’emploi l’amènent aujourd’hui à siéger au conseil
d’administration de la Villa Numéris (think-tank digital européen) et de la Conférence des Grandes Ecoles (CGE). Isabelle est aussi business angel,
investissant dans des start-ups en amorçage dans le domaine du digital et de l’impact, en particulier via 50 Partners et GENERATIONS powered by EDHEC.

speakers.function: lecturer in accounting and business processes

He is also co-author of Bedrijfsprocessen de baas – Praktijkgids ERP in Odoo, a hands-on guide that helps students understand how areas such as sales, purchasing, inventory, production and accounting connect within a real organisation.

speakers.name: Aurore Lesage
speakers.biography_html:
Aurore began her journey at Odoo 14 years ago as an Office Officer, where she collaborated closely with all departments - Accounting, HR, Sales, Consulting, and R&D. This role gave her a deep understanding of the company and its people. She later transitioned into a Business Analyst position, implementing Odoo solutions for clients both in Belgium and internationally.

At the time, customer support was more of a concept than an established function, so Aurore took on the challenge of creating, shaping and improving Odoo’s Customer Service. Through years of dedication and hard work, she now leads Odoo’s Worldwide Support, overseeing operations across 8 countries.

speakers.name: Tom Sandinha
speakers.biography_html: Tom Sandinha is a Senior Functional Consultant at Scalizer, a French consulting firm specializing in ERP and CRM implementations. With 3 years of Odoo experience, Tom built his expertise around no-code client onboarding on Odoo Online — a discipline that demands a deep mastery of standard mechanisms to translate real business needs without a single line of custom code. That same philosophy drives his work on long-term rental: at Odoo Experience 2026, he shares how a well-configured Odoo out-of-the-box can fully support LTR contracts and automated monthly billing.

speakers.name: Daniel Heinen
speakers.biography_html: Daniel Heinen has served on the board of Bundesblock (German Blockchain Association) since 2022 and sits on the supervisory board of Blockchain Europe, the joint venture of Fraunhofer and TU Dortmund University. A trained business economist and serial entrepreneur, he is the inventor and founder of HEINI — a patent-protected, agentic AI platform that turns Odoo into the backbone of a self-running company. He combines deep blockchain governance experience with a hands-on builder's mindset, translating emerging technology into practical tools for the German Mittelstand. Daniel is also a proud father of five.

speakers.name: Tim Freudenthal
speakers.biography_html: Tim Freudenthal is co-founder and Managing Director of HLR GmbH, a dynamic company from Hamburg that specializes in the rental of highly specialized lifting and hoisting technology. With a clear focus on quality, safety and flexibility, he has made it his mission to combine proven technical solutions with digital innovation. As an engineer with many years of experience in the industry, Tim knows the challenges of the operational business just as well as the need for efficient processes. Together with his team, he has actively shaped the digital transformation at HLR - and established Odoo, a platform that combines all central processes in one system. In his talk, he provides authentic insights into the practical side of things: from individual rental processes and the management of technical documentation to multi-level warehouse logistics. He will show how digitalization not only improves internal processes, but also enhances the customer experience.

speakers.name: Pieter Jan Van Wettere
speakers.biography_html:
Pieter-Jan Van Wettere holds an MSc in Strategic Marketing from Coventry University, earned while a student job at Colruyt Group was quietly turning into a ten-year retail career.
Those ten years taught him the fundamentals: how a store runs, and how to lead the people running it.
 
From there he moved into retail operations at Lidl, then joined furniture group Beliving as regional sales manager.
He worked his way through buying into category leadership, ending as Category Director for the Exterioo format — nearly ten years of learning how a retail organisation holds together from the stores upward.
 
In 2025 he became COO of Flamant, the Belgian interiors and lifestyle brand, leading the operational organisation across four retail stores, e-commerce, and a wholesale network.
Shortly after, he took on the migration to Odoo — from the business side rather than the IT side, which is exactly what this talk is about.

speakers.name: Average Rob
speakers.biography_html:
Average Rob is a Belgian content creator known for combining humor, adventure, and authenticity in everything he does. He brings a unique mix of playfulness and storytelling to every project. Rob doesn’t just make videos, he fully immerses himself in the worlds he explores. Whether it’s training like a professional athlete, experiencing an unfamiliar culture or city, or taking on extreme challenges, he brings his audience along for the ride and is unstoppable when it comes to pushing limits. Alongside his brother Arno The Kid, his partner in crime, Rob turns chaos into content.

Beyond content creation, Rob is a dynamic entrepreneur and marketeer. As the driving force behind the Belgian beer brand Tout Bien, he shapes not just the product but also its creative marketing side, community engagement, and brand identity. Week by week, the team and the Tout Bien brand continue to grow, establishing themselves as a recognized and trusted name in the market. On top of that, he is also one half of a DJ duo with Omdat Het Kan, delivering high-energy sets to Belgian festival crowds year after year.

From content to branding, marketing, and music, Rob dives in headfirst: always authentic and never afraid to push boundaries.

Previously, Johan doubled EasyPost’s revenue to €16M, grew Board of Innovation’s EMEA business to €8M for clients like Nestlé and the World Economic Forum, and built and sold a logistics company. Today, his mission is simple: helping organizations find the clarity they need to stop playing small and reach their full potential.

speakers.name: Caroline Lair
speakers.biography_html: Caroline Lair sits at the intersection of technology, social sciences, and spirituality, bringing a rare perspective to one of the most consequential questions of our time: what kind of AI do we want to build, and for what future? With a background spanning startups, investment, and entrepreneurship, she founded The Good AI and co-founded Women in AI — a global community of 15,000+ members across 100 countries. Today, as an investor and speaker, she works with organizations navigating the tension between technological acceleration and the values they claim to hold. Inspired by Solarpunk thinking, she champions a pragmatic and intentional vision for AI, one that serves regeneration, inclusion, and the future we actually want to build.

speakers.name: Akhmad Daniel Sembiring
speakers.biography_html:
Akhmad is the CEO and Founder of VITRAINING, an Indonesian technology consultancy with over two decades of enterprise ERP implementation experience. As an Odoo contributor since 2010, VITRAINING has delivered end-to-end Odoo implementations for more than 100 organizations across Indonesia, spanning state-owned enterprises (BUMN), agribusiness conglomerates, manufacturing companies, and government agencies.
His current focus areas include AI-augmented ERP workflows using DeepSeek and ChatGPT, custom Odoo frontend development with Apache ECharts and OWL framework, blockchain integration for supply chain traceability, and carbon credit verification platforms. Akhmad brings a rare combination of deep technical expertise and ground-level business understanding from one of Southeast Asia’s most dynamic emerging markets.
He is a regular contributor to the Indonesian Odoo community and is passionate about bridging the gap between enterprise-grade ERP capabilities and the operational realities of businesses in Southeast Asia.

speakers.name: Mathias Leroy & Victorine Therasse
speakers.biography_html:
Mathias joined Odoo in 2022 as a Senior Business Advisor in the Mid-Market & Corporate (MMC) team. He works with mid-sized and large organizations across Europe, helping them evaluate how Odoo can support their business transformation.

By understanding each customer's context, challenges, and objectives, Mathias leads the discovery phase and designs tailored demonstrations that validate how Odoo addresses their business requirements. Working within Odoo's unique editor-and-integrator model, he collaborates closely with Odoo internal implementation consultants and Odoo's product teams to ensure customers benefit from both deep functional expertise and direct product knowledge.

Beyond the software itself, Mathias advises customers on structuring their discovery analysis to define a realistic implementation scope, timeline, and budget. His experience spans organizations with both local and international operations, supporting them from the early evaluation phase through to a successful implementation.

---

Having joined Odoo eight years ago, Victorine began as a Business Analyst and Project Manager, supporting small and medium-sized businesses. She later moved into the MMC department as Project Director. Throughout her time at Odoo, she has applied and refined Odoo's implementation methodology across projects of various sizes and industries. She leads these projects by managing internal Odoo teams, ensuring smooth coordination from start to finish. This hands-on experience has given her a deep, practical mastery of how to deliver Odoo implementations effectively.

speakers.name: Bright Obeng
speakers.biography_html:

With a background in finance, controlling, executive search and media, Bright has built a unique perspective on how the CFO role is evolving. Through De CFO Podcast, he has interviewed CFOs, entrepreneurs, board members and thought leaders on value creation, leadership, technology, growth, risk and decision-making.

These conversations, combined with his own experience in finance and entrepreneurship, form the foundation of his first book, published by Pelckmans. His work focuses on the evolution of finance from a reporting and control function into a strategic capability that helps organisations make better decisions and create more sustainable value.

With a dual background in computer science and mathematics, Daniel approaches digital transformation from a deeply analytical perspective, seamlessly bridging the gap between high-level business strategy and deep-dive technical execution.

Throughout 8 years dedicated to the Odoo ecosystem, Daniel has guided 50+ successful implementations and holds certifications across 9+ Odoo versions. A seasoned veteran of the Odoo Experience stage (2019, 2024, 2025), he is recognized for his ability to translate intricate technical architectures into actionable business growth. Beyond Odoo, his expertise spans Python programming, Machine Learning, SEO optimization, and cybersecurity—reinforced by his credentials as a Harvard-certified Cybersecurity Risk Manager.

A true "multilingual" professional, Daniel navigates five human languages and five machine languages, ensuring that stakeholders and technology always speak the same language. Driven by his "J.A.D.G." philosophy—Journey, Acceleration, Digital Integrity, and Growth—his mission is to help the community build secure, innovative, and future-proof systems that turn Odoo from a software solution into a strategic engine for innovation.

speakers.name: Thomas Deville
speakers.biography_html: Thomas Deville, aged 40, describes himself as the coordinator of a collective of entrepreneurs committed to sustainability. After studying civil engineering alongside a complementary master’s degree in management and entrepreneurship, he quickly found his niche in this coordinating role, taking on responsibilities as a team leader, operations manager, finance manager and recruitment manager. In 2018, he was commissioned by the engineering consultancy Deplasse to coordinate the implementation of an ERP system. Thomas currently serves as managing director of the ALTEO Group and as financial director for all the group’s subsidiaries. In these two roles, he oversees the group’s internal coordination and ensures the well-being of the ALTEO Group’s 150 employees.

speakers.name: Rutger Hofste
speakers.biography_html:
Rutger Hofste is a data scientist and entrepreneur focused on secure, AI powered business systems built on Odoo. He works with SME+ and enterprise clients in strategically sensitive industries, helping them scale Odoo to meet higher security and identity management requirements. As founder of Pantalytics, he develops advanced solutions around Odoo, AI, and security, including email hardening, SSO, automated user provisioning, and enterprise grade access control on Odoo.sh and Odoo Enterprise.

Rutger combines a strong analytical background from TU Delft and the National University of Singapore with hands on experience building production ready systems. His work bridges real client demands with responsible security practices, including responsible disclosure and upstream contributions to the Odoo ecosystem.

speakers.name: Kushal Darji
speakers.biography_html:
As a Manager of Customer Success, I work closely with clients to ensure they are able to use Odoo effectively in their day-to-day operations. My role involves guiding customers through implementation, supporting them as they grow, and helping them solve challenges along the way.

I believe in keeping things simple and practical, focusing on what truly works for the customer. Through my experience, I’ve seen how the right approach to customer success can make a big difference. At Odoo Expo, I’m excited to share a few real examples and insights that others can easily relate to and apply.

speakers.name: Maulik Raval
speakers.function: Odoo ERP Solution Architect at Brainvire
speakers.biography_html:
Maulik Raval is a certified Odoo ERP Solution Architect and Project Manager at Brainvire with over 11 years of techno-functional experience spanning Odoo versions v6 to v19 Enterprise.

He specializes in solution architecture, end-to-end ERP implementations, and scalable system design across diverse industries, including manufacturing, retail, supply chain, and logistics.

Having led on-site discovery workshops, UAT, and successful multi-country rollouts across regions such as Canada, Singapore, the UAE, and Thailand, he is dedicated to driving digital transformation and helping global enterprises scale efficiently with Odoo.

He is growing Orelus with the ambition to build a modern, proactive and technology-driven HR partner for Belgian SMEs. His work combines Belgian social law, payroll coordination, employment documentation and operational HR processes.

speakers.name: Kristian Gram Krogh & Diogo Duarte
speakers.biography_html:
Kristian Korgaard is a CTO and technology leader with nearly 25 years of experience working with ERP systems, business processes, and enterprise IT.

For the past five years, he has worked extensively with Odoo, starting with Odoo 14 and following the platform through its continued evolution. His experience spans ERP architecture, integrations, finance, retail, logistics, e-commerce, and the practical implementation of business processes in Odoo.

In his current role as CTO at GreenMind, Kristian combines technology leadership with a hands-on approach to architecture and development, using Odoo as a central part of the company’s business platform.

Diogo Duarte is the CTO and Founder of ERPGap, a company specializing in delivering tailored ERP solutions to clients worldwide. As a certified Odoo Partner operating in both the UK and the United States, ERPGAP supports organizations across the globe in optimizing their business processes and digital infrastructure.

Before founding ERPGAP, Diogo built a strong foundation through 15 years of experience in the construction, industrial, and railway sectors. This hands-on industry background gives him a practical, results-driven perspective on technology, allowing him to bridge the gap between complex operational challenges and effective digital solutions.

speakers.name: Alfredo Prieto Rodrigo
speakers.biography_html: Alfredo Prieto Rodrigo is Director of Business Acceptance at EPI Company, where he leads the expansion of Wero, Europe’s emerging pan-European payment solution. Based in Brussels, he brings extensive experience in the payments and financial services industry, with a strong focus on merchant acceptance, business development, and digital commerce. Prior to EPI, he held roles at Bancontact Payconiq Company, FIS, and Euroclear, working across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Alfredo is passionate about driving innovation in payments and shaping the future of account-to-account and mobile transactions in Europe.

speakers.name: Clémentine Cailleau
speakers.biography_html:
Clémentine Cailleau is the Odoo Functional Leader at Metrum, the Odoo Business Unit of the Resultance Group, where she leads the development of functional standards, implementation methodologies and project governance across the organization.

With nearly five years of experience in digital transformation and operational excellence, she specializes in designing business-driven Odoo solutions that help companies improve performance while keeping implementations scalable and maintainable.

Throughout her career, she has led and advised complex ERP transformation projects across industries including retail, distribution, manufacturing and services. Her expertise spans business process design, solution architecture, implementation strategy and change management, with a strong focus on maximizing the value of standard Odoo while identifying where targeted custom developments and AI can create sustainable competitive advantages.

Passionate about bridging business strategy and technology, Clémentine regularly supports project teams on complex functional decisions and contributes to the continuous evolution of implementation best practices within the Resultance Group.

speakers.name: Sébastien BOSSOUTROT
speakers.biography_html:
Co-presented by Sébastien Bossoutrot (IROKOO) and Thomas Othax (HIPE / Packitoo).

Sébastien Bossoutrot is co-founder and Co-CEO of IROKOO, one of France's leading Odoo Gold Partners.
An engineer who spent years working inside the packaging industry, he knows the trade from the shop floor up. Before IROKOO, he spent five years as an ERP project manager and pre-sales lead on a product vertical built for the packaging sector, bridging operations, business needs and software. A certified Odoo expert (v14 to v19) and functional architect, he now helps organizations turn Odoo into the operating system of their business.

Thomas Othax is the founder and CEO of Packitoo, a French software editor that aims to improve sales operations in the packaging industry.
Packitoo has developed HIPE, the first CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) solution designed for the packaging industry, and is today launching a platform dedicated to creating AI agents for this sector.
Started in 2017, Packitoo has joined BOBST Group since 2024, one of the world’s leading suppliers of substrate processing, printing and converting equipment and services for the label, flexible packaging, folding carton and corrugated board industries.

speakers.name: MARTINEZ Philippe & Noémie Keller
speakers.biography_html:
Former IT Manager in the scientific sector, Philippe Martinez spent more than 40 years supporting researchers by providing IT solutions tailored to their needs. He is currently a volunteer Vice President of the GCU, in charge of Information Technology, where he contributes to the association's digital strategy. Working alongside a project team made up of employees, board members, and Sodexis, he contributed to the deployment of Odoo within the GCU. He enjoys sharing practical experience and lessons learned from real-world Odoo implementations.

Noémie (Nemo) originally completed her bachelor of science in Biomedical Engineering at the Johns Hopkins University in the USA. After her studies, she pivoted into IT Consulting with Deloitte in Washington D.C., USA. In 2022, she founded the Sodexis Switzerland office in Geneva to lead the expansion of Sodexis services in Europe. She is passionate about using technology to solve the world’s most pressing problems and aid businesses. With 10 years of experience in IT consulting and a strong engineering background, she is uniquely qualified to help organizations translate their business workflows into Odoo and reimagine their business operations.

speakers.name: Yasmin Dahdouh
speakers.biography_html:
Yasmin Dahdouh is an Account Executive at Odoo, where she has been working for over two years. She started her journey through the Young Graduate program, which gave her hands-on experience across three key departments: Support, Business Analysis, and Sales. This path provided her with a 360° view of the entire customer lifecycle. From the initial sale to implementation and long-term support.

Driven by a passion for human connections and business operations, Yasmin helps over 100 small businesses streamline their daily operations every year. She has also hosted several international Odoo Academies, specializing in topics like e-invoicing.

Working closely with small companies, she understands that launching an ERP without dedicated internal resources can feel overwhelming. Her talk aims to provide small teams with practical, actionable guidance to give them the initial boost they need for a smooth Odoo kickoff.

speakers.biography_html:
Eri Nikaido, Team Leader Japan at Odoo Hong Kong  

As the Indirect Team Leader, Eri spearheads Odoo’s expansion into Japan through building a robust local partner network. In 2026, Eri led a 150% increase in Odoo subscriptions in Japan. Passionate and goal-driven, she offers deep insights into pushing digital transformation with a unique localized perspective regarding Japan's distinct business culture. Drawing on 4 years of market experience, Eri offers a rare blend of global operational insight and local cultural fluency—helping Japanese businesses modernize their operations using international best practices tailored to their distinct needs.

speakers.name: Jade W. Dagher
speakers.biography_html:
Jade W. Dagher is the founder & CEO of Expand Strategies, a boutique consultancy firm specialized in the development of strategy and business development for SMEs. He is all about constantly expanding on a personal and professional level. He holds a Bachelor of Banking and Finance degree from NDU, Lebanon. His background in banking, feasibility studies, and financial planning for individuals, startups, and medium-sized businesses inspired the birth of Expand Strategies in 2002.

As a Certified Management Consultant, CMC © and a member of the CMC-GI- Certified Management Consultants Global Institute, he has operated in several countries in the MENA region and has had the honor of engaging with various nationalities. He was appointed as Professional Development Committee Chair by the Board on the recommendation of the Governance and Nominating Committee and confirmed by the Board of ICMCI. Jade became partner & CEO at BLIS Global Solutions after 7 years of being a project manager for BLIS Experience; this social enterprise has more than 100 experts, working in 25 countries to raise the awareness of financial & business planning, and building strategic alliances between 10 complementary professions. Check out more on www.blis-global.com

With hundreds of clients benefiting from the training workshops he has been conducting since 2006, Jade received a Certificate of Appreciation from The Cisco Entrepreneur Institute-AMIDEAST in recognition of his dedication in 2012.

Jade was a trainer for the Citi Foundation, a member of The Ideaz Prize’s panel, a trainer for the Women Empowerment initiative at BLC bank, a judge in the Grow my Business competition, and a mentor for the Mowgli Foundation and SME toolkit Initiative. He was also a Sales and Risk Management university professor and a volunteer consultant for INJAZ, a member of Junior Achievement Worldwide.

As a fire walker/mentee with Anthony Robbins, he has taken the adventure of improving the standards of entrepreneurship in the region upon himself by bridging the gap between the academic and real world.

Jade believes in the power of planning, organization, and discipline to be able to expand to a different level. He also leverages the power of technology and continuous learning.

tracks.name: Masterclass - Odoo Web Framework
tracks.description_html:
This Masterclass will be held before the Odoo Experience Event, over two days, Tuesday, September 22nd and Wednesday, September 23rd, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Entrance to the Masterclass includes breakfast, lunch, and drinks during both days.

Prerequisites

Attendees should have intermediate knowledge of Odoo and a basic understanding of javascript.

Why attend?

This year, Owl (Odoo’s javascript UI framework), has undergone a major refactoring. Owl 3 introduces a new reactivity model based on signals and a completely new plugin system. At the same time, many features have been simplified or redesigned, significantly changing how components are written, composed, and maintained. These changes improve correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability of UI code, but they also require non-trivial migrations for existing Owl applications. This training provides a hands-on, in-depth exploration of Owl 3, focusing on its core concepts—including signals, component lifecycle, rendering semantics, hooks, and plugins—and their practical usage within the Odoo web client.

Specifically, the training will cover:

-Owl 3.0: architecture and core concepts 
-The Odoo javascript framework design principles 
-Writing and organizing javascript code in the Odoo web client and website 
-Migration strategies from Owl 2.x to Owl 3.x

tracks.name: Masterclass - Scaling Odoo x Odoo.sh
tracks.description_html:
This Masterclass will be held before the Odoo Experience Event, over two days, Tuesday, September 22nd and Wednesday, September 23rd, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Entrance to the Masterclass includes breakfast, lunch, and drinks during both days.

This course is divided in two parts : One about Scaling Odoo & Performance and the second part about Odoo.Sh

Prerequisites

A laptop running any Linux flavor, with an up-to-date Python and PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with Odoo’s development environment is recommended, but not mandatory.
For performance: basic knowledge of Python, SQL and command line.
For deployment: basic knowledge of networking and Linux sysadmin.

Who should attend?

This Masterclass is ideal for developers, testers, and QA engineers working with Odoo, or anyone interested in gaining expertise in testing methodologies tailored to Odoo’s architecture & Odoo.sh.
The class will blend theory and hands-on exercises, ensuring you leave with actionable insights to improve the quality of your Odoo applications.

Architecture and performance:

This part is designed to give you the guidelines to deploy an Odoo instance.
From the smallest one to bigger ones, and covering subjects like horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, multi-tenant infrastructure, as well as the various layers involved in an Odoo infrastructure.
Once deployed, you’ll be taught various methodologies to handle performance issues in an Odoo instance, from good practices during coding to issues root cause identifications.

Odoo.Sh :

This part provides the technical foundation for managing Odoo.sh projects. You’ll learn how to set up projects and understand how Odoo.sh differs from traditional deployments. We’ll dive into the development lifecycle: integrating custom apps, testing, debugging and upgrading from one version of odoo to the next, while teaching you how to use built-in platform tools to resolve issues.

tracks.name: Masterclass - Studio Expert
tracks.description_html:
Go beyond standard settings and master the art of advanced business tailoring.

This Masterclass is an intensive two-day deep dive held before the Odoo Experience Event, over two days, on Tuesday, September 22nd and Wednesday, September 23rd, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Your registration includes full catering (breakfast, lunch, and drinks) for both days.

Prerequisites: A solid understanding of Odoo’s ecosystem. This session is designed for those who have moved past the basics and are ready to gain total control over their Odoo environment.

Note: This class is specifically curated for those looking to reach the highest level of proficiency with Studio. If you are only looking for a surface-level overview, this advanced deep-dive may exceed your current needs.

Master Your Workflows

Welcome to the Studio Expert Master Class. This session is designed for users who want to bridge the gap between "standard features" and "perfect-fit solutions." We focus on the high-level logic and advanced configurations that allow you to transform Odoo into a bespoke tool for any business challenge.

Throughout this session, you will explore the full depth of Studio’s capabilities. You will learn how to design sophisticated data connections, refine the user experience through advanced view logic, and orchestrate complex business processes that run themselves.

Expert Curriculum

Deep-Level Customization:

  • Data Integrity: Mastering complex field relationships and relational data logic.

  • System Navigation: Optimizing the interface for high-efficiency business operations.

Advanced UI & PDF Report:

  • Dynamic Views: Refining Kanban, List, and Pivot views to surface critical business insights.

  • Professional Reporting: Engineering tailored PDF reports that consolidate data from across your entire system.

Business Logic & Governance:

  • Strategic Automations: Creating multi-step triggers and advanced server actions to eliminate manual tasks.

  • Access Governance: Implementing granular security, access rights, and record rules to maintain professional standards.

Take complete command of your Odoo platform. Join us and become a Studio Expert.

tracks.name: Masterclass - Odoo Web Framework
tracks.description_html:
This Masterclass will be held before the Odoo Experience Event, over two days, Tuesday, September 22nd and Wednesday, September 23rd, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Entrance to the Masterclass includes breakfast, lunch, and drinks during both days.

Prerequisites

Attendees should have intermediate knowledge of Odoo and a basic understanding of javascript.

Why attend?

This year, Owl (Odoo’s javascript UI framework), has undergone a major refactoring. Owl 3 introduces a new reactivity model based on signals and a completely new plugin system. At the same time, many features have been simplified or redesigned, significantly changing how components are written, composed, and maintained. These changes improve correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability of UI code, but they also require non-trivial migrations for existing Owl applications. This training provides a hands-on, in-depth exploration of Owl 3, focusing on its core concepts—including signals, component lifecycle, rendering semantics, hooks, and plugins—and their practical usage within the Odoo web client.

Specifically, the training will cover:

-Owl 3.0: architecture and core concepts 
-The Odoo javascript framework design principles 
-Writing and organizing javascript code in the Odoo web client and website 
-Migration strategies from Owl 2.x to Owl 3.x

This Masterclass will be held before the Odoo Experience Event, over two days, Tuesday, September 22nd and Wednesday, September 23rd, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Entrance to the Masterclass includes breakfast, lunch, and drinks during both days.

This course is divided in two parts : One about Scaling Odoo & Performance and the second part about Odoo.Sh

Prerequisites

A laptop running any Linux flavor, with an up-to-date Python and PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with Odoo’s development environment is recommended, but not mandatory.
For performance: basic knowledge of Python, SQL and command line.
For deployment: basic knowledge of networking and Linux sysadmin.

Who should attend?

This Masterclass is ideal for developers, testers, and QA engineers working with Odoo, or anyone interested in gaining expertise in testing methodologies tailored to Odoo’s architecture & Odoo.sh.
The class will blend theory and hands-on exercises, ensuring you leave with actionable insights to improve the quality of your Odoo applications.

Architecture and performance:

This part is designed to give you the guidelines to deploy an Odoo instance.
From the smallest one to bigger ones, and covering subjects like horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, multi-tenant infrastructure, as well as the various layers involved in an Odoo infrastructure.
Once deployed, you’ll be taught various methodologies to handle performance issues in an Odoo instance, from good practices during coding to issues root cause identifications.

Odoo.Sh :

This part provides the technical foundation for managing Odoo.sh projects. You’ll learn how to set up projects and understand how Odoo.sh differs from traditional deployments. We’ll dive into the development lifecycle: integrating custom apps, testing, debugging and upgrading from one version of odoo to the next, while teaching you how to use built-in platform tools to resolve issues.

tracks.name: Zero-Click Gmail Integration for Odoo CRM: Fully Automated Email Logging
tracks.speaker_line: Simon Stappen, Managing Partner at Much. Consulting
tracks.description_html:
This talk will unveil a powerful Gmail integration for Odoo that revolutionizes how businesses handle email communication in their CRM and beyond. Unlike the standard Gmail-to-Odoo sync, which relies on manual user intervention and unpredictable behaviors, this integration is designed for complete automation. It operates silently in the background, continuously scanning relevant Gmail accounts, intelligently matching emails with Odoo records (e.g., leads, opportunities, partners, tasks), and logging communication threads without requiring any clicks or user confirmation. The result: sales teams, project managers, and customer support agents can work entirely in Odoo, confident that every client interaction is tracked, centralized, and accessible — without the usual overhead.

We'll dive into the technical architecture, show the smart matching logic (e.g., by email address, subject tokens, thread detection), and cover real-world implementation tips. This approach is ideal for organizations aiming to enhance CRM transparency, streamline workflows, and reduce manual data entry.

Key Points:

- Why the standard Gmail sync isn’t good enough: gaps, manual steps, and risks
- Designing a true zero-click email integration for CRM, Helpdesk, Projects
- How matching logic works: intelligent threading, fallback strategies, contact recognition
- Architecture overview: Google APIs, cron jobs, Odoo models, and custom logic
- Deployment insights: access security, scalability, and performance tips
- Real-world results: reduced time-to-update, full conversation visibility, user adoption gains

Key Learnings:

- How to architect a background sync that is reliable, scalable, and fully automated
- Best practices for linking emails to Odoo objects with high accuracy
- How to handle edge cases like shared inboxes, aliases, and partial matches
- The hidden costs of manual CRM email management (and how to eliminate them)
- Boosting user satisfaction and CRM hygiene through invisible automation

Target Audience:

- CRM Managers and Admins seeking better user adoption and data accuracy
- Sales and Customer Support Leaders wanting full communication visibility
- Odoo Developers and Integrators looking to build or improve external email connectors
- Business Owners and Decision Makers evaluating CRM usability and ROI

tracks.name: Bank sync: How it works & what's new?
tracks.speaker_line: Louis Luneau from Odoo
tracks.description_html:
This session will be structured around three main segments to provide a complete overview of Odoo’s Bank Sync feature and its latest developments.

The first part will introduce Bank Sync, explaining its purpose, key benefits, and how it works. This segment will include a live demonstration of the feature, as well as an overview of the supported bank synchronization providers.

The second part will focus on what’s new in Bank Sync, presenting the latest improvements and features while addressing common customer questions and concerns. This section will exclude the “initiate payment” feature and concentrate on the most relevant updates for users.

The final segment will be dedicated to a live FAQ session, where we will answer questions collected from the audience through the dedicated pad and provide further clarification on topics of interest.
Additional details to follow

tracks.name: Ditching the Patchwork: A Biotech Startup's Bet on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Béla Surányi & Balázs Boga, Principal Consultant & Co-Founder (COO) at FF Advisors & Microbiom Center
tracks.description_html:
Microbiom Center in Târgu Mureș is the first clinic in Romania dedicated exclusively to the human microbiome, founded by a second generation Romanian entrepreneurial family.

Like many young firms in the region, the team started with a patchwork of tools: a WordPress site, a medical booking plugin, and several disconnected applications. Every change depended on an outside developer, which made the operation slow and costly.

This talk tells the story of the move to Odoo and what changed once a single platform replaced that patchwork.

The clinic now runs CRM, online booking with a book and pay later option, the website connected to a patient portal, a detailed patient database, full inventory linked to sales, invoicing with Romanian E-Factura, vendor bills, financial reconciliation, leave management, and email marketing inside one system. Invoicing and reminders are automated, and every test is traceable through the inventory module. The owners and team now make changes on their own and gain value from each new Odoo release.

The session also frames a wider pattern: many Eastern European firms founded in the 1990s face a triple transition at once: real operational digitalization, a generational handover of ownership, and a shift toward an AI driven economy.

Drawing on the speaker’s work as a family business advisor, the talk shows how an integrated ERP can carry a company through all three.

Key learnings: why unifying the stack beats stitching together point solutions, ⁠how to move a team from developer dependency to self sufficiency, and ⁠how integrated modules compound in value for a biotech operation.

Target audience: founders, ⁠family business owners, ⁠operators, ⁠advisors, and ⁠Odoo partners working with companies in transition.

tracks.name: Rethinking the Energy Transition
tracks.speaker_line: Stefan Grosjean, Founder & CEO of Smappee/ Snowball at Smappee/ Snowball
tracks.description_html:
The energy transition is changing how we generate, store and use energy. But unlocking its full potential requires more than renewable energy alone. It requires intelligence.

In this keynote, Stefan Grosjean, Founder & CEO of Smappee, shares his vision for a smarter energy future, shaped by more than three decades of entrepreneurship and innovation. Through personal insights and lessons learned, he explores how intelligent energy management can help create a more flexible, connected and sustainable energy system.

An inspiring perspective on energy, technology and the power of thinking differently combined with a clear view on the future.

speakers.name: Stefan Grosjean
speakers.biography_html:
Stefan Grosjean (°1963) grew up in Flanders, Belgium, and earned a Master of Science in Industrial Engineering, specializing in Computer Science and Electronics. In 1991, Stefan founded EnergyICT, a pioneering company in energy solutions for commercial and industrial businesses. Over the next two decades, EnergyICT became a global leader in energy management technologies, laying the foundation for Stefan’s reputation as a visionary in the clean-tech industry. He sold the company in 2009.

Building on this success, in 2012 Stefan founded Smappee, an innovative company that focuses on optimizing energy consumption and accelerating the transition to renewable energy. Smappee is internationally recognized for its intelligent EV chargers and smart energy management solutions, which blend functionality with sleek design. Under his leadership, Smappee has won numerous prestigious awards, including the Henry Van De Velde Award, the Red Dot Award, and the iF Design Award. As of October 2024, Stefan transitioned to the role of CEO of Smappee Group, the umbrella body over the various Smappee ventures. In this new role, he remains closely involved in Smappee's management but with a sharpened focus on the visionary innovation and strategy of the Group to ensure Smappee's accelerated growth and leading position in the industry.

In addition to his role at Smappee, Stefan founded  Snowball in 2018, a cutting-edge Cleantech Hub in Harelbeke. Snowball serves as the headquarters of Smappee and acts as a collaborative space and living lab for clean-tech innovation, bringing together companies and experts focused on sustainable energy and environmental solutions.

With over 30 years of experience, Stefan is a recognized leader in the global energy transition, consistently striving to blend cutting-edge technology with high-functioning design and sustainable growth strategies. His passion for innovation and commitment to positive societal and environmental impact continue to drive his entrepreneurial ventures.

tracks.name: From POS to Pocket: Extending Odoo to Your Customers
tracks.speaker_line: Eric Friedlingstein, Founder & Odoo Solution Architect at Synapsis-Group
tracks.description_html:
Short description

Discover how a Belgian bar transformed Odoo into a complete customer engagement platform through a native mobile application featuring daily specials, loyalty rewards, push notifications, and customer feedback.

Abstract

For many restaurants, Odoo starts with the Point of Sale. But what if it could also become the platform that keeps customers coming back?

This talk presents the real-life implementation of a customer-facing mobile application developed for Le Caberdouche, a famous Belgian bar that recently migrated its operations to Odoo.

Instead of relying on multiple third-party services for customer communication, loyalty management, and customer feedback, everything is managed natively inside Odoo.

The mobile application allows customers to:
• Receive weekly and daily specials through push notifications
• Collect loyalty points and redeem rewards
• Review and provide instant feedback
• Stay connected through a simple and intuitive mobile experience

Behind the scenes, Odoo becomes the single source of truth for both restaurant operations and customer engagement.

During this 20-minute session, we will demonstrate:
• How Odoo powers a modern native mobile application
• How push notifications increase customer engagement and repeat visits
• How loyalty programs can be fully integrated without external services
• How customer reviews collected directly inside Odoo provide valuable business insights
• Lessons learned while designing a mobile experience that customers actually enjoy using
• How a single Odoo backend powers both business operations and customer engagement

This session demonstrates how Odoo can evolve from an ERP into a complete customer engagement platform, helping hospitality businesses strengthen customer relationships, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless digital experience.

tracks.name: Zippsafe: Scaling a startup with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Janos Regele, Maximilian Bernhard from Odoo
tracks.description_html:
Zippsafe AG is an innovative Swiss technology scale-up that has revolutionized the traditional employee locker room. 

Originating from ETH Zurich in 2016, the company replaces rigid metal or wooden lockers with an intelligent, IoT-connected "Smart Soft Locker" system. By utilizing flexible, durable textile bags instead of hard materials, Zippsafe's solutions save up to 70% of floor space while increasing storage capacity up to threefold.

Engineered with advanced RFID locking, integrated ventilation, and antimicrobial fabrics, their systems bridge the gap between physical space-efficiency and digital workflow optimization. Today, Zippsafe operates across three continents with a growing team of over 90 employees across Switzerland, Germany, Hungary, and the USA, providing smarter, highly hygienic storage solutions to major healthcare facilities, pharmaceutical sites, and industrial sectors globally.

Janos Regele, Head of Product Development and ICT will speaking about his experience introducing Odoo and using its modular and open source design to scale from just a few people to almost 100 employees across the world.

Janos is also currently leading one of the most well organised and executed upgrade projects we have seen.

Stop by to hear about the journey, its guranteed to be interesting for companies at all stages of their development and also for clients who are planning or undergoing an upgrade!

Website: https://www.zippsafe.com/en

tracks.name: Warranty Repairs Done Right: Managing Vendor Repairs with Odoo Helpdesk & Repairs
tracks.speaker_line: Nadja Planic, Head of Manufacturing ERP Consulting at much. Consulting
tracks.description_html:
Many service providers and B2B resellers manage repair processes under warranty not for themselves, but for the original vendors. When a product fails, customers submit helpdesk tickets—but what happens next? Without structured flows, companies struggle to track repairs, returns, and vendor chargebacks.

This talk shows how to create a seamless repair flow in Odoo. We’ll focus on how to handle third-party repairs, using Odoo's Repair, Helpdesk, Inventory, and Project apps.
You’ll leave with a complete framework to manage warranty repairs, ensure traceability, and provide service transparency—while keeping vendor relations and SLAs under control.

Key Points:

- The challenge: Coordinating repairs on behalf of OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) or vendors
- Helpdesk as the entry point: Ticketing with product & warranty tracking
- Creating a structured repair intake: RMA (Return Merchandise Authorisation), stock intake, and repair order
- Using Odoo Repair and Project apps to track repair work and approvals
- Charging vendors post-repair: Purchase/Sales workflows for B2B warranties
- Case study examples from real repair service operations

Key Learnings:

- Understand how to build a repair process linked to helpdesk tickets in Odoo
- Learn how to manage repairs performed on behalf of third-party vendors
- Gain practical tips for handling returns, parts usage, and documentation
- See how to charge vendors transparently after completed repair work
- Avoid common pitfalls in repair-service traceability and SLA compliance

Target Audience:

- Service operations managers and repair coordinators
- ERP consultants working with after-sales or technical support providers
- Companies providing repairs under vendor warranty or service contracts
- Helpdesk administrators and process designers in B2B service companies

tracks.name: From Startup to International Retail: Scaling 50+ POS with Odoo at GoodNews
tracks.speaker_line: Matias Righi, Functional Consultant at QubiQ 2010, S.L
tracks.description_html:
How do you scale a fast-growing retail startup from a handful of stores to an international operation, without losing operational control, speed at checkout, or visibility over your business?

In this session, we will share the GoodNews journey: a modern food & beverage retail brand that expanded rapidly across Spain, France, Amsterdam, and now the UK all powered by Odoo. What started as a startup with ambitious growth plans quickly became a complex multi-store operation running 50+ Point of Sale sessions simultaneously, requiring real-time stock control, seamless integrations, and a checkout experience designed for high-volume environments.

We will walk through how Odoo became the operational backbone of GoodNews, covering key challenges such as scaling POS performance, handling peak-hour concurrency, improving order preparation flows, and integrating external systems without breaking store operations. You’ll also see how process redesign and smart POS customizations helped reduce friction for store staff while increasing transaction speed and reliability.

Key takeaways include:

1) How to prepare Odoo POS for high-concurrency, multi-store retail environments
2) Lessons learned when scaling operations across multiple countries
3) How operational efficiency at POS directly impacts growth and customer experience
4) The importance of combining standard Odoo features with targeted custom development

tracks.name: Untangling Excise Duties: Managing Bonded Wine & Spirits Warehousing in Odoo Standard
tracks.speaker_line: Julien Brunin & Samy Brahimi, CEO et Business Analyst at Acsone
tracks.description_html:
With over a century of history, Les Vins Brunin-Guiller is a major actor in wine and spirits retail, import, and export across Belgium and France. But behind every fine bottle lies a complex web of customs regulations, bonded warehouses (hors douane), and excise duties.
Unlike standard taxes like VAT, excise taxes in the alcohol sector are triggered at a very specific and critical moment: when the product leaves the tax-suspended customs regime (hors douane) and is cleared for domestic market distribution. Managing this dual-status inventory and ensuring tax compliance across purchases, internal transfers, and sales is a notorious nightmare for wine merchants.
In this talk, we will reveal how we successfully implemented a fully compliant, integrated flow for Vins Brunin-Guiller. You will discover how we leveraged Odoo Standard—using multi-warehouses, specific route configurations, and native inventory features—to automate excise tax calculations and track every stock movement from purchase to final delivery.
What you will learn (Key Takeaways):
- Bonded vs. Duty-Paid Flows: How to design a seamless multi-warehouse and location structure in Odoo to manage tax-suspended (hors douane) and tax-paid stocks.
- Automating Excise Triggers: How to capture the exact moment excise duties must be applied during stock moves, minimizing human error and audit risks.
- The Power of Standard: Practical tips and tricks to solve complex regulatory and localization issues using Odoo’s native features, avoiding heavy custom developments.
- Real-world Feedback: Lessons learned from a century-old business transitioning to a modern, integrated ERP.

tracks.name: Modern Transport Management for road transportation with Odoo: From CRM to Delivery
tracks.speaker_line: Robert Förster, CEO at SUPPLiot GmbH
tracks.description_html:
The logistics industry demands much more than accounting and inventory. Transport companies need to manage quotations, dispatching, vehicles, drivers, deliveries, invoicing, and customer communication—all while keeping operations efficient.

In this session, we’ll show how Odoo serves as the foundation for a complete Transport Management System (TMS). Starting with standard Odoo applications such as CRM, Sales, Fleet, Purchase, Accounting, we’ll demonstrate how an integrated ERP eliminates data silos and streamlines day-to-day logistics operations.

We’ll then explore how industry-specific workflows can be added on top of Odoo to support transport planning, dispatching, proof of delivery, driver operations, telematics integration and logistics-specific processes—all while remaining fully integrated with the Odoo ecosystem.

Whether you’re an Odoo partner looking to enter the logistics industry or a transport company evaluating Odoo, this session demonstrates how a modern logistics platform can be built by combining Odoo’s powerful standard features with targeted industry expertise.

tracks.description_html:
In this talk, I’ll share how we’re building a practical skills matrix to get clear, reliable visibility into capability across the business - who holds certain skills and capabilities, at what level, and where our most critical shortfalls and single points of failure exist. We’ll look at how the matrix strengthens business continuity by enabling smoother handovers, clarifying ownership, and ensuring there are trained backups for key roles and processes, reducing risk when people are away or when staff churn happens.

I’ll also cover how we use structured skills assessments to evaluate current proficiency levels consistently, so the matrix is based on evidence rather than assumption. Beyond continuity planning, I’ll explain how we’re using the same framework to drive focused upskilling and development plans, ensuring training is aligned to real operational needs.

Finally, we’ll explore how the insights directly inform recruitment and hiring decisions - highlighting which skills should be developed internally, which require external hiring, and where future roles or capacity gaps are emerging. Attendees will leave with a clear, actionable approach for implementing a skills matrix that improves resilience, accelerates team growth, and supports smarter workforce planning.

Every retailer has a goal: growing sales, protecting margins, or simply staying consistent over time. But goals without visibility are just wishes. To move forward, you need to track your progress, understand what's working and what's not, and act fast.

Mastering project profitability in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Dries Van Doninck, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_html: Tracking the true profitability of a project can be challenging when timesheets, vendor bills, and expenses are managed across different teams. Without a centralized system, it’s easy to lose the overview of what costs are actually made, and which profits you are actually creating. In this session, we will map a project's financial lifecycle to see exactly how margins are calculated in real-time in Odoo 20. We first configure baseline data, like employee hourly rates, service products, and material costs. These will  be used to demonstrate how analytic accounts can be set up to automatically capture daily operations like timesheets, expenses, purchase orders, and vendor bills of the project. We will conclude by going over the standard reporting capabilities of Odoo 20, by integrating Odoo Spreadsheets to build functional budgets and identify financial variances before they impact your bottom line.

tracks.name: Raising AI Pentesters - from Toddler to Teenager
tracks.speaker_line: Robbe Verwilghen
tracks.description_html:
Robbe is an experienced bug bounty hunter, ex-triager and ex-penetration tester. Last year, he joined Aikido Security's AI pentest team to use their agents in security research and help improve the product.

In this presentation Robbe will talk about how he experienced the launch of Aikido's AI pentest agents and how he has seen the agents evolve. You’ll learn that there's much more to AI Pentesting than just high benchmark scores. While a tool might ace a controlled test, it’s useless if it can’t navigate a live more complex application flow. Robbe will share the practical, real-world capabilities that benchmarks often miss, such as handling SMS and email magic links and working with exotic authentication mechanisms, a standard set of AI pentest agents might not be able to navigate.

tracks.name: Choosing Odoo Over SAP: The 10-Year Transformation Journey of a Global Pharmaceutical Group
tracks.speaker_line: Amit Parik, Managing Partner at BrowseInfo
tracks.description_html:
In 2014, Sasmar Pharmaceuticals faced a critical strategic decision.

Operating across multiple countries with growing manufacturing, distribution, and eCommerce operations, the company evaluated traditional enterprise ERP platforms, including SAP, to support its next phase of international growth. Instead, Sasmar selected Odoo (formerly OpenERP), a decision that would shape the next decade of its business transformation.

Today, Sasmar operates 22 companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, North America, and Latin America, with Odoo serving as the digital backbone of its global operations.

This session is not a software implementation story. It is a business transformation case study.

We will explore how Sasmar evolved from a group of 6 companies into a globally integrated pharmaceutical organization while maintaining a single ERP strategy, standardized operating model, and unified data architecture. Attendees will gain insight into the governance, scalability, and architectural decisions that enabled rapid international expansion without the complexity and fragmentation commonly associated with multinational growth.

The session will cover:

* The ERP evaluation process and why Sasmar selected Odoo over traditional enterprise alternatives.
* Designing an ERP architecture for future expansion rather than current requirements.
* Building a centralized multi-company, multi-currency, and multi-warehouse operating model.
* Supporting manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and commercial operations across multiple countries.
* Managing more than 25 Shopify stores, Amazon channels, websites, and digital commerce operations through a unified platform.
* The evolution from Odoo 7 to Odoo 19 and lessons learned from a decade of continuous innovation and upgrades.
* Governance frameworks, customization strategies, and scalability principles that enabled long-term success.

More importantly, we will share what worked, what failed, what we would do differently today, and the practical lessons organizations can apply when building a long-term ERP roadmap.

For CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CIOs, ERP leaders, and growing international businesses, this session demonstrates how Odoo can move beyond departmental automation to become a strategic platform for global expansion.

Ten years ago, Sasmar chose Odoo as an ERP system.

A decade later, it has become the foundation that supports 22 companies, multiple continents, global manufacturing, digital commerce, and continued growth.

This is the story of how an ERP decision became a business transformation journey.

⸻

Why This Session Matters

Most ERP discussions focus on software features.

This session focuses on what business leaders truly care about:

How do you build an ERP foundation that can support international growth, acquisitions, new markets, digital commerce, and operational complexity for more than a decade without replacing the platform every few years?

Using Sasmar Pharmaceuticals’ real-world journey, attendees will see how strategic ERP decisions, governance, and scalable architecture can enable sustainable global growth while avoiding the costs, disruption, and complexity often associated with large-scale ERP transformations.

⸻

Speaker Perspective

Delivered jointly by the leadership teams of Sasmar Pharmaceuticals and BrowseInfo, sharing over ten years of practical experience scaling one of Odoo’s longest-running global pharmaceutical implementations.

tracks.name: Odoo for Aerospace: Enforcing No-Fly Zones in the Warehouse
tracks.speaker_line: Bernhard Hilfer, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_html:
In aerospace manufacturing, storing a standard prototype in a restricted "Flight-Critical" zone is not merely an operational error; it is a severe compliance breach that jeopardizes safety certifications and audit status. Managing this across complex bills of materials requires infallible, automated segregation of physical inventory based on strict component compliance levels.

To solve this, we expanded the Odoo Enterprise Inventory and Barcode apps to engineer a rigid "Compliance Flag" setup. By binding specific compliance attributes directly to Serial Numbers and Stock Locations, the system enforces a strict key-lock matching rule during every internal stock move. If a warehouse operator attempts to scan a non-compliant part into a restricted zone, it instantly triggers a hard stop within the Odoo Barcode interface, preventing the transaction.

As a result, zone mistakes dropped to absolute zero. Automating these checks during scanning also cut manual quality assurance time by 40%, keeping warehouse operations fast without sacrificing safety. Attendees will discover the exact data model changes, the barcode logic setup, and practical lessons for enforcing strict compliance in a busy warehouse environment.

Key Points of this Talk:

- Data Model Extension: Extending standard Odoo Serial Number and Stock Location models to support unique compliance attributes.
- Key-Lock Matching Logic: Engineering strict validation rules that pair component safety flags directly with destination zone restrictions.
- Real-Time Barcode Enforcement: Configuring automated hard stops inside the Odoo Barcode UI to block incorrect physical scans instantly.
- Preventing Segregation Breaches: How the system physically keeps non-compliant aerospace parts out of secure storage areas.
- Fallback Handling: Executing smart routing logic to guide standard inventory to regular shelves without breaking warehouse workflows.

Key Learnings:

- How to enforce strict Serial-to-Location validation in Odoo Enterprise Inventory.
- How to trigger hard validation stops in the Enterprise Barcode UI.
- How to architect scalable compliance rules for highly regulated industries.

Target Audience:

Supply Chain Directors, QA Managers, and Technical Consultants using Odoo Enterprise.

tracks.name: Meet Lisa, Billie, Leon & Lex: Four AI Agents That Go Live in Your Odoo — No Tech Team Required
tracks.speaker_line: Marc Bogaerts, CEO at Coreflow Technology
tracks.description_html:
What if your Odoo could reorder stock before you run out, flag a risky contract close before you sign, chase late invoices without anyone touching a keyboard, and surface the deals most likely to close this week — all without a single developer on your payroll?
That's exactly what Coreflow built. Four AI agents that plug directly into an existing Odoo environment. Billie handles procurement and inventory — calculating safety stock, reorder points and EOQ from three years of your own sales data. Leon monitors budgets, runs a 13-week rolling cashflow forecast, and triggers dunning below a configurable threshold. Lisa qualifies leads, tracks pipeline health, and drafts outreach without leaving Odoo. tracks.name: Aerospace Compliance in Odoo: The EHP & Idealis Production & Traceability Success Story
tracks.speaker_line: Benoit Dassy, Business Analyst at Idealis Consulting
tracks.description_html:
In the aerospace industry, there is absolutely zero room for error. A single defective component or a lapse in documentation can jeopardize a multi-million-dollar satellite mission. To operate in this elite sector, manufacturers must comply with draconian quality standards (such as ECSS and AS9100). How can a modern, agile ERP like Odoo meet such rigid, high-stakes requirements?

Discover the real-world success story of EHP (Euro Heat Pipes), a prominent aerospace manufacturer that overhauled its production ecosystem by implementing Odoo with the strategic support of Idealis.
This talk will deep dive into how Odoo MRP, Quality, PLM, and Inventory modules were leveraged to enforce strict manufacturing flow, bidirectional lot/serial traceability from raw material to orbit, and robust non-conformity management. We will explain how we bridged the gap between Odoo’s natural flexibility and the extreme compliance required by space agencies.

Key takeaways from this session:
- Space-Grade MRP & Quality: How to configure and enhance Odoo to meet strict international aerospace compliance without losing operational agility.
- Bulletproof Traceability: Best practices for setting up end-to-end lot tracking and mandatory quality checkpoints across complex, high-precision production lines.
- Industrial Scaling: How Idealis and EHP successfully transitioned operators from legacy, paper-heavy workflows to a digitized, integrated ERP.

Target Audience: Manufacturing Managers (in the Space Industry or similar needs about traceability), Quality Assurance (QA) Experts,.

Is your ERP implementation set up for success—or already heading toward avoidable problems?

Most ERP implementation failures are not caused by the software itself. They result from common project risks that, if left unmanaged, can lead to delays, budget overruns, and poor user adoption.

In this session, you'll learn the most common risks organizations face when implementing Odoo with a partner and, more importantly, how to mitigate them before they become costly issues. We'll cover practical approaches to project governance, working effectively with your implementation partner, and recognizing the right moment to involve Odoo if your project starts going off track.

Whether you're about to begin your implementation or are already in the middle of one, you'll leave with actionable insights to help you reduce risk, make better project decisions, and increase the likelihood of a successful implementation.

You'll learn how to:

  • Identify the most common implementation risks.
  • Apply practical strategies to mitigate them.
  • Manage your implementation effectively from day one.
  • Establish the right governance and project expectations.
  • Know when and how to involve Odoo before an implementation derails.

If you're planning an implementation with an Odoo Partner and want to maximize your chances of success, this session is for you.

tracks.name: Batir le futur des métiers à l'heure de l'IA générative
tracks.speaker_line: Isabelle Rouhan from Colibri Talent
tracks.description_html:
Lors de ses interventions, Isabelle Rouhan invite chacun à découvrir une série de métiers du futur, et notamment à toucher du doigt l’impact concret que
l’intelligence artificielle générative a sur le travail. Elle en est convaincue, les nouvelles technologies libéreront des tâches répétitives et sans valeur ajoutée pour permettre d’investir ce temps additionnel dans plus de formation et de relation. Ce sera notamment le cas dans les services d’aide à la personne et les métiers de la relation client. En effet, l’accélération de la collecte et du traitement des data sera un formidable moteur de création d’emplois et de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles. De l’artiste numérique, à l’éducateur de robots, en
passant par le neuro-manager ou encore le médecin numérique, Isabelle partage a vision d’un monde plus humain et plus riche où l’Intelligence Artificielle se met
au service de l’Homme, quand l’agilité permet à chacun de devenir acteur de son employabilité. En s’appuyant sur les témoignages d’artistes, d’entrepreneurs, d’enseignants, d’agents du service publics, loin de tous partis pris ou de stéréotypes, elle compose une galerie de portraits des métiers de demain, dont le dénominateur commun est qu’ils soient tous connectés.

tracks.name: How to build a project agreement framework in Odoo for complex wholesale distribution
tracks.speaker_line: Tânia Manco, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_html:
Construction wholesale is built on long-term, multi-partner B2B projects. Standard Odoo handles sales and procurement well, but the specific demands of such complex supply chains require a more tailored approach. Managing project-level pricing, dual delivery methods (dropship vs. warehouse), and contracts across dozens of subcontractors requires stepping outside the standard setup. This talk explores how to build an "Agreement Framework" that connects these moving parts into one unified process.

Key Points of the Talk:

- Find the Gap: Identifying where out-of-the-box Odoo features like blanket orders and pricelists reach their limits in complex distribution scenarios.
- The Agreement Framework: Designing a central model that links sales and purchasing, tracks quantities in real time, and automates price inheritance.
- Live Demo: A walkthrough of creating an agreement, comparing margins between delivery routes, and watching child orders automatically update project balances.
- Architecture & Logic: The reasoning behind our technical choices, specifically how we handled unit of measure conversions and automated margin calculations.
- The Future: A brief look at upcoming Odoo features and why a dedicated orchestration layer will still matter for specialized industries.

Key Learnings:

- Why building a dedicated "Agreement" model is more stable than extending standard sales or purchase orders.
- How to store "Dropship vs. Warehouse" prices for the same agreement to enable easy comparisons.
- Lessons learned from aggregating real-time data across various stages of the supply chain.
- The importance of allowing agreements to apply to product groups, not just individual SKUs, to handle substitutions.
- Why secondary units of measure and custom order states must be part of the initial architecture, not an afterthought.

Target Audience:

- Functional Consultants & Developers looking for ways to extend Odoo for complex trading and distribution.
- IT Leads & Project Managers at companies dealing with multi-partner agreements or intricate B2B pricing.
tracks.description_text:
Construction wholesale is built on long-term, multi-partner B2B projects. Standard Odoo handles sales and procurement well, but the specific demands of such complex supply chains require a more tailored approach. Managing project-level pricing, dual delivery methods (dropship vs. warehouse), and contracts across dozens of subcontractors requires stepping outside the standard setup. This talk explores how to build an "Agreement Framework" that connects these moving parts into one unified process.
Key Points of the Talk:
- Find the Gap: Identifying where out-of-the-box Odoo features like blanket orders and pricelists reach their limits in complex distribution scenarios.
- The Agreement Framework: Designing a central model that links sales and purchasing, tracks quantities in real time, and automates price inheritance.
- Live Demo: A walkthrough of creating an agreement, comparing margins between delivery routes, and watching child orders automatically update project balances.
- Architecture & Logic: The reasoning behind our technical choices, specifically how we handled unit of measure conversions and automated margin calculations.
- The Future: A brief look at upcoming Odoo features and why a dedicated orchestration layer will still matter for specialized industries.
Key Learnings:
- Why building a dedicated "Agreement" model is more stable than extending standard sales or purchase orders.
- How to store "Dropship vs. Warehouse" prices for the same agreement to enable easy comparisons.
- Lessons learned from aggregating real-time data across various stages of the supply chain.
- The importance of allowing agreements to apply to product groups, not just individual SKUs, to handle substitutions.
- Why secondary units of measure and custom order states must be part of the initial architecture, not an afterthought.
Target Audience:
- Functional Consultants & Developers looking for ways to extend Odoo for complex trading and distribution.
- IT Leads & Project Managers at companies dealing with multi-partner agreements or intricate B2B pricing.

tracks.name: When Intelligence Becomes Free: Lessons from Letting AI Operate Odoo Across 60+ Modules
tracks.speaker_line: Miguel Martín, CEO at Aikit
tracks.description_html:
Odoo 19 brought AI into the ERP: Ask AI, AI fields, agents that help the people using Odoo. This talk is about the step after that — software built to be operated by AI, not by people.
The reason matters. For 300,000 years, progress was capped by one scarce resource: intelligence. As that scarcity ends, "AI inside the ERP" is only the first move; the deeper shift is software designed for an AI operator.
AiKit is a Spanish AI lab whose product runs natively on Odoo for 2,000+ SMBs. With live, working examples, we'll show how we built an AI layer that reads, decides and writes across 60+ Odoo modules and 200+ external systems via MCP and the Odoo API — an operator, not a chatbot or a copilot.
Attendees will leave with a concrete architecture for AI that operates Odoo end-to-end; the guardrails that keep it safe on real ERP data; the failure modes we hit at scale and the fixes; and a clear view of how this extends — rather than replaces — Odoo's native AI.
For Odoo partners, developers and functional consultants building AI into real client deployments.
