tracks.name: 50% Faster Quotes & 90% Fewer Errors: A Practical Approach to Configure-to-Order CPQ in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Arpit Sheth, Business Head at Aktiv Software Pvt. Ltd.
tracks.description_html:
50% Faster Quotes & 90% Fewer Errors: A Practical Approach to Configure-to-Order CPQ (Custom Product Configurator) in Odoo

Custom and configure-to-order manufacturers all face the same hard problem: every quote is unique, the number of possible product combinations runs into the thousands, and a single wrong attribute can flow all the way to the shop floor as a costly error. Many teams still handle this complexity manually, which is slow, fragile, and hard to scale.

This session walks through a practical, reusable approach to configure-to-order CPQ in Odoo, drawn from real configure-to-order implementations. We will cover how to structure product attributes and variants so the configurator stays manageable instead of exploding, how to drive accurate bills of materials straight from the configured quote, and how Aktiv’s Odoo CPQ solution enables you for this transformation. Across these implementations, the approach has cut quoting time by roughly half and reduced configuration errors by up to 90% by removing manual rework.

With our live demonstration, attendees will learn how to:

- Configure complex products with dynamic pricing rules
- Handle complex scenarios with custom dimensions using Parametric Configuration
- Automate proposal generation and streamline approval workflows
- Enhance customer satisfaction with accurate and timely product configurations
- Optimize manufacturing workflows with dynamic Bill Of Materials (BoM)
- Leverage the integration with Odoo Sales, Purchase, Inventory & Manufacturing modules for a unified solution

Join us at Odoo Experience 2026 to discover how Odoo CPQ can transform your sales and manufacturing operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth in your business.

tracks.name: Managing A Complete Cycle of Events and Roadshows from Marketing to Building an Ecosystem
tracks.speaker_line: Jade W. Dagher, CEO at EXPAND STRATEGIES LTD
tracks.description_html:
Many events fail not because of content or speakers, but about lack of proper planning and the right system to manage the cycle from idea to project management and cash flow.

We used Odoo to move a visionary idea to somehting more concrete:
- Built a website for more clarity and visibility
- Marketed the website through social media, email marketing, marketing automation, webinars, and much more.
- All marketing channels were redirected to the events pages on the website, specifying the speakers, sponsors, exhibition booths, ticketing history of the previous years and much more.
- Documents module was used to show the latest version of each sponsorship package, flyer, pricing, where only the latest version was showing in the same url, which were all tracked for monitoring
- CRM was used to generate leads, monitor their journey on the website, and enrich the lead info through each stage of the process
- Project module was used to manage the info and the stages of every single part of the process and delegate and monitor each task internally and externally, using tasks count and timesheets where applicable.
- Online appointment was used to ease the management of the meetings depending on availability, connected to Google calendar
- Knowledge was used to consilidate the email templates and standard communication templates as well as floor plan and much more.
- Sales and accounting were used to auto generate quotations from the website and auto issue the invoices upon payment done online
- Recruitment modulle was done to recruit in mass, filtering fast and choosing the right candidates upon needs to help in the event management.
- Bar code was used to spot attendance in each event and help knowing with whom to communicate based on their attendance status and level of ticket (vip or standard or online)
- Survey was used to engage with the audience, share the statistics and re-engage with the physical then the online audience for better alignment and credibitlity.

All the above was done with zero code, no development background, using 80% standard and 20% studio. Results were fantastic over 5 years, community growing to over 10,000, attendees over 3,000, released unnecessary costs, excel files, unlimited brainstorming, and much more.

speakers.name: Jade W. Dagher
speakers.biography_html:
Jade W. Dagher is the founder & CEO of Expand Strategies, a boutique consultancy firm specialized in the development of strategy and business development for SMEs. He is all about constantly expanding on a personal and professional level. He holds a Bachelor of Banking and Finance degree from NDU, Lebanon. His background in banking, feasibility studies, and financial planning for individuals, startups, and medium-sized businesses inspired the birth of Expand Strategies in 2002.

As a Certified Management Consultant, CMC © and a member of the CMC-GI- Certified Management Consultants Global Institute, he has operated in several countries in the MENA region and has had the honor of engaging with various nationalities. He was appointed as Professional Development Committee Chair by the Board on the recommendation of the Governance and Nominating Committee and confirmed by the Board of ICMCI. Jade became partner & CEO at BLIS Global Solutions after 7 years of being a project manager for BLIS Experience; this social enterprise has more than 100 experts, working in 25 countries to raise the awareness of financial & business planning, and building strategic alliances between 10 complementary professions. Check out more on www.blis-global.com

With hundreds of clients benefiting from the training workshops he has been conducting since 2006, Jade received a Certificate of Appreciation from The Cisco Entrepreneur Institute-AMIDEAST in recognition of his dedication in 2012.

Jade was a trainer for the Citi Foundation, a member of The Ideaz Prize’s panel, a trainer for the Women Empowerment initiative at BLC bank, a judge in the Grow my Business competition, and a mentor for the Mowgli Foundation and SME toolkit Initiative. He was also a Sales and Risk Management university professor and a volunteer consultant for INJAZ, a member of Junior Achievement Worldwide.

As a fire walker/mentee with Anthony Robbins, he has taken the adventure of improving the standards of entrepreneurship in the region upon himself by bridging the gap between the academic and real world.

Jade believes in the power of planning, organization, and discipline to be able to expand to a different level. He also leverages the power of technology and continuous learning.

As construction projects scale from simple builds to multi-story developments, flat spreadsheets and basic job management apps quickly fall apart. Coordinating complex project phases, managing unpredictable supplier pricing, and dealing with chaotic site logistics can easily wipe out a general contractor's margins before they even notice.

Building on the success of Construction Builder industry, this session introduces Construction Developer one, engineered for businesses tackling larger and more complex projects. We’ll skip the basic workflows and focus directly on solving your biggest operational headaches: quoting efficiently with the most up-to-date supplier prices, orchestrating heavy multi-vendor procurement, tracking inventory straight to the active job site, and protecting project profitability from unbilled change orders.

Come see how Odoo helps bridge the gap between your estimation desk and the field, giving your teams a clearer, unified view of logistics and costs throughout the project lifecycle.

tracks.name: Automating Late Payment Fees with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Douae Amzir from Sodexis
tracks.description_html:
Title
Learn how to automate finance charges and late payment fees in Odoo to improve cash flow and reduce manual follow-up.
Description
Late payments are a common challenge for businesses of all sizes, impacting cash flow and increasing the administrative burden on accounting teams. Calculating and applying penalties manually is often time-consuming and prone to errors.
In this session, we will explore how the Finance Charge module enables organizations to automatically apply late payment fees to overdue invoices while maintaining transparency and consistency with customers.
Attendees will discover how to:
Configure finance charge rules and policies.
Define grace periods and penalty percentages.
Automatically generate finance charges on overdue invoices.
Notify customers and maintain clear communication.
Integrate finance charges seamlessly with Odoo Accounting.
Handle disputes and exceptional cases.
Improve collections and reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
Adapt the solution to different legal and business requirements.
Through practical examples and a live demonstration, we will show how Odoo can help businesses automate accounts receivable processes and encourage timely payments without increasing administrative overhead.
Whether you are an accountant, financial manager, consultant, or Odoo implementer, this session will provide practical guidance for building a more efficient and proactive credit management process.

Type: Customization
Edition: Entreprise
Form: Talk
Version: 19
Modules: Accounting, invoicing,

The live demonstration will showcase:
Configuring finance charge policies.
Defining grace periods and charge percentages.
Creating customer invoices.
Simulating overdue payments.
Automatically generating finance charge invoices.
Managing exceptional cases and waiving charges when necessary.
Measuring the impact on the collection process and cash flow.

tracks.name: Ticket Sales Done Right: A Practical Guide to Managing Events with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Vadim Rau, Senior Business Analyst at Sodexis Austria
tracks.description_html:
Organizing an event—whether it's an exclusive corporate seminar, a large-scale expo, or a community meetup—can quickly turn into a logistical headache if your ticketing, marketing, and on-site check-in systems are disconnected.
This talk provides a practical, step-by-step guide to unifying your entire event management process using the Odoo Events app. We will explore how to launch a fully functional, branded event website in minutes, enabling seamless online self-registration for your attendees.
Beyond just selling tickets, this session covers the complete attendee lifecycle. You will learn how to enforce venue capacity limits, automatically dispatch digital tickets, and set up automated pre-event reminders to reduce no-shows. Furthermore, we will demonstrate how to easily integrate sponsors into your event pages to give them the visibility they deserve, culminating in a live look at how to run a frictionless, professional on-site registration desk using Odoo's built-in QR code scanning.

Key Highlights

- Rapid Event Website Creation: Learn how to spin up an engaging, customized event landing page in minutes and easily send out invitations to your target audience.

- Seamless Self-Registration & Ticketing: See how to enable attendees to register online, select their ticket tiers, and automatically receive their digital tickets via email.

- Capacity & Attendee Management: Discover how to effectively manage your guest list and strictly enforce maximum attendee limits to prevent overbooking.

- Maximizing Sponsor Visibility: Explore native Event App tool to prominently feature and manage event sponsors, adding value to your partnerships directly on the event page.

- Automated Communication: Learn how to configure and trigger automatic email or SMS reminders leading up to the event to keep your attendees engaged and reduce no-shows.

- Frictionless On-Site Check-In: Watch a demonstration of how to speed up the door queues by registering attendees on-site using quick and reliable QR code scanning from their digital tickets.

tracks.name: How ENGIE Vianeo Runs EV Billing on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Vincent Vandenberge, Head of Digital at Engie
tracks.description_html:
ENGIE Vianeo runs its entire EV billing infrastructure on Odoo — from raw charging session data to compliant invoices, delivered in 16 weeks.
This session covers how ENGIE Vianeo and VS Digital built a production-ready billing engine on Odoo Enterprise: CDR ingestion, rule-based pricing (flat, kWh, time-based, hybrid), B2C and B2B invoicing, subscription management, pre-payment reconciliation, and SAP export.
Key takeaways: how to use Odoo as a financial sub-ledger for high-volume transactional data, how to integrate Salesforce, a mobile app, Okta SSO, and SAP in a single delivery, and how to make a fixed-price contract viable on a project of this complexity.

tracks.name: From NetSuite to Odoo: A CEO’s Journey to Simpler, Smarter ERP Adoption
tracks.speaker_line: Dr. Wong Kee Wei, Founder & Group CEO at Safety Ware
tracks.description_html:
In this customer success story, Dr. Wong Kee Wei, Founder and Group CEO of Safetyware Group, will share a practical CEO-level perspective on moving from Oracle NetSuite to Odoo. Safetyware Group is a Malaysian PPE and safety solutions company that grew from an SME into a public-listed group with manufacturing, trading, training, and technology-related operations.

As the company scaled, the team needed an ERP platform that could support better process discipline without becoming too costly, complex, or difficult for users to adopt. This session explains why Safetyware decided to migrate to Odoo, what the team learned during implementation, and how Odoo helped streamline daily operations, improve process visibility, reduce software-related costs, and gain stronger acceptance from employees due to its more intuitive interface and lower learning curve.

The talk will focus on lessons that business owners, CFOs, COOs, IT managers, and transformation leaders can apply when evaluating ERP options. Key takeaways include how to assess ERP fit beyond features, how to win user buy-in, how to manage migration risk, and why SMEs should treat ERP implementation as a business transformation project rather than a software project.

The audience will leave with a realistic reference point from an Asian growth company that has experienced both enterprise ERP and Odoo in real operations.

tracks.description_html:
Title
Discover how to build a complete learning platform in Odoo to train employees and customers by creating courses, managing access, and delivering engaging content.
Description
This talk demonstrates how Odoo's eLearning module can become a centralized platform for teaching and learning, enabling companies to create professional training programs for employees, partners, and customers.
Attendees will learn how to transform knowledge into structured courses and deliver training in a scalable and user-friendly way.
During this session, we will cover:
An overview of the Odoo eLearning module and its capabilities.
Creating and organizing courses into sections and lessons.
Uploading various types of content, including videos, documents, presentations, and quizzes.
Managing visibility and access rights for internal employees, portal users, and customers.
Publishing courses and controlling who can enroll.
Tracking learner progress and course completion.
Using certifications and quizzes to assess knowledge.
Best practices for onboarding new employees and educating customers.
By the end of the session, attendees will understand how to leverage Odoo eLearning to reduce training costs, improve knowledge sharing, and provide a better experience for both employees and customers.

tracks.name: A Safe Blueprint to Migrate your SaaS Billing to Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Tomás Van Loock, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_html:
Fast-scaling B2B SaaS platforms often face a critical dilemma: their external subscription billing engine operates separately from their financial backbone, forcing accounting teams to manually reconcile thousands of fragmented transactions. If the business now reorganises internal processes, moving all at once to a new ERP system is risky. In that situation, consultants need to find a way to link the existing and new systems without disrupting everyday work.

Instead of forcing a high-risk immediate transition, we designed a phased integration strategy anchored directly in Odoo Accounting. y configuring a controlled, on-demand synchronization workflow via API, we bypassed the unpredictability of real-time webhooks, giving the finance team absolute control to pull, construct, and fully reconcile multi-currency invoices, payments, and credit notes securely within Odoo's standard accounting models.

This strategic phase-one deployment eliminated manual cross-system data entry entirely, guaranteeing absolute financial accuracy across the organization. As a direct result, the automated workflow instantly reduced the monthly financial close from 15 days down to 5, buying the client the operational stability required to systematically plan their eventual phase-two migration into native Odoo Subscriptions.

Key Points of this Talk:

- Executing a phased integration strategy to stabilize operations during internal organizational flux.
- Unifying external subscription billing data directly with Odoo Enterprise Accounting models.
- Automating multi-currency invoice creation and payment reconciliation to eliminate manual entry.
- Bypassing complex real-time webhooks in favor of highly controlled, on-demand financial synchronizations.
- Securing absolute accounting veridicality across disconnected systems before a full ERP migration.
- Reducing the financial close from 15 days to 5 days on the first execution.

Key Learnings:

- How to evaluate a phased custom integration strategy vs. an immediate full platform migration.
- How to map external subscription lifecycle states to standard Odoo Enterprise financial workflows.
- How to mitigate project risk by delivering immediate operational ROI before proposing system-wide migrations.
- How to give finance teams control over data synchronizations without relying on volatile push notifications.
- How to utilize temporary external connectors as a strategic stepping stone toward Odoo Subscriptions.

Target Audience:

Functional Consultants, Project Managers, and Finance Directors.

tracks.name: How Odoo Spreadsheets kill your need for customization
tracks.speaker_line: Gert-Jan Ras, Business Analyst at dear digital
tracks.description_html:
Every customization request starts the same way: "Odoo can't do exactly what we need." Often it can, without a line of code. This talk works through real cases where Odoo Spreadsheets replaced custom development: calculating min and max stock levels automatically from sales data, running dynamic quality checks, and building price calculations that update themselves. We show how each one was built, what it would have cost as custom code, and where the spreadsheet approach has its limits. You leave able to tell, in your own projects, when to reach for a spreadsheet instead of a developer. Less custom work, less maintenance, more control.

This presentation is aimed at functional consultants, Odoo admins, and the power users who maintain Odoo in-house.

Key takeaways:

Concrete cases where Odoo Spreadsheets replace custom development
How to build min/max stock, quality checks, and dynamic pricing without code
Where the spreadsheet approach ends and real customization begins

tracks.name: Measure, snap, quote, note: Digitize your field operations with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Mathieu Herbos from Odoo
tracks.description_html:
A large part of an SME's sales activity happens outside the office: at the client's home, in a showroom, on the road. The data created there is where deals are won or lost, but it often gets stuck between a notebook, a phone gallery and a WhatsApp thread before it ever reaches the CRM.

In this talk, we follow the real-life journey of a kitchen designer and fitter, from the first lead to the signed order. A prospect fills in a form on the website, a salesperson qualifies the lead and books a home visit, takes measurements and photos on site, builds the quotation on the tablet with product variants and options, and gets the client to sign on the spot.

Along the way, we'll show how CRM and Sales, combined with Odoo's mobile experience, help SMEs shorten their sales cycle, close deals on-site, and make sure no lead ever gets lost between the showroom and the field.

tracks.name: The Red Lions spirit: a winning culture and high team performance
tracks.speaker_line: Cedric Charlier, Olympic Champion I Keynote Speaker | Partner Manager Odoo
tracks.description_html:
18 years. 382 international matches. European, World and Olympic titles.

An 18-year journey at the highest level of international hockey, as part of the Belgian Red Lions and their historic transformation from a second-tier hockey nation into the world’s number one team.

This journey was about far more than sporting talent. It was about building a shared ambition, creating a strong team culture, developing trust and accountability, raising standards, embracing setbacks and learning how to perform together under pressure.

The Red Lions spirit: a winning culture and high team performance

How does a team transform from a second-tier nation into the number one team in the world?

This keynote takes the audience behind the Red Lions’ journey and explores the principles that enabled this transformation: a clear vision, a shared purpose, high standards, resilience, trust and collective accountability.

The lessons of elite sport go far beyond the hockey field. They provide powerful insights into leadership, teamwork, culture and sustainable performance — and into what it takes to turn ambition into consistent collective success.

- Real-time Profitability: Generating bulletproof margin reports based directly on vendor invoice lines, providing the management team with perfect financial visibility.

tracks.name: Run your real estate business with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Emma Brandy from Odoo
tracks.description_html:
Real estate operations often stall when data must manually transition between disconnected tools during a property’s lifecycle. Fragmented systems complicate everything from vendor onboarding and automated buyer matching to fee calculations and rental contract management. 

This session demonstrates how the Real Estate Agency and Property Management modules unify these steps into a single, continuous workflow. 

We will explore how a new property listing automatically triggers subscriber matching, routes inbound marketplace leads into a structured nurturing pipeline equipped with visit scheduling and offer shortcuts, and seemlessly calculates commission fees. Finally, we will look at the back-office transition, converting a buyer into a property management client, and automating recurring rent invoicing directly inside the ERP.

tracks.name: Odoo Has Eyes: Connecting Smart Cameras and Sensors to Your ERP
tracks.speaker_line: Alexander De Waele, Managing Partner at Konu BV
tracks.description_html:
Odoo is already a powerful platform for managing sales, inventory, accounting, POS, manufacturing and many other business processes. But in many companies, valuable operational data is still captured outside Odoo: by cameras, sensors, machines, counters or other external devices.
In this talk, we present Komeet, a project developed at Konu to connect intelligent cameras and external sensors with Odoo. The use case we will focus on is automatic visitor counting in a retail context. Instead of relying on manual estimates or separate analytics tools, a smart camera counts the number of visitors entering a store and sends that information to Odoo.
Using practical examples, we will show how this kind of integration can create value: combining visitor data with POS results, measuring conversion rates, improving staffing decisions, following up store performance or exploring similar use cases in logistics, manufacturing and service environments. The session is meant to inspire Odoo partners, developers and business users to think of Odoo as a platform connected to the physical world.
